title: Coconut Milk Pulao
ingredients:
2 cup Jeera/Basmati rice(soak for 20 mins)
1 onion(sliced)
1 tomato(sliced)
1 inch ginger
5 cloves of garlic
 2 Green Chilli
10 mint leaves
10 coriander leaves
2.5 cup coconut milk
 1.5 cup water
1 tea spoon of Garam Masala
 Salt
 1 table spoon Ghee
1 table spoon Coconut oil
 Briyani items (Brinji leaves -1, Star anise -1, Cinnamon -1, Jeera seeds -1 tea spoon, Cardamon-3)
steps:
Take a Pressure Pan and add 1 table Spoon of Coconut Oil
Add all briyani items one by one
Saute the sliced onion
Add sliced tomato
Make ginger garlic + green chilli as a paste and add into the pan
Add the mint and coriander leaves
Saute the above items for 5 mins until the raw smell goes
Add Coconut Milk and water as per the measurement
Boil it for 2 mins
Add necessary salt and Garam Masala at this stage
Add the soaked Jeera/Basmati rice and boil it until it cooks around 50 to 60% and water levels down to the surface of rice
Close the pressure pan and keep it the lower burner in the stove and put in SIM mode for 7 mins
Turn Off the flame after 7mins and wait for another 5 minutes, then open the pressure pan and add 1 table spoon of ghee
Delicious Pulao is ready to serve!
Preferred Side dishes:
Honey Chilli Potato
Mushroom Pepper Fry
